lines.text: Your stored account says ninety seconds, then a denial. I can read what's on it. I won't put words into the grille.
Nine years of headers. Ferrymen names, according to the log. I run a yard, not an address register. The older headers still don't say who assigned them.
Depot's allocation says six years around intact track. Your crate copy has the same consignment ID. I keep the timetable. That entry still needs explaining.
Ring-two depot, no loss in your book. Amber, Dispatch calls it. I watch the road, not a colour. I'd still like to know what set that rating.
Stay with the convoy on your work card. Dispatch writes the rating; you bring the people back.
Dispatch posts the escort work. Read the route and the rate. I say bring a spare magazine.
Gate opens on Dispatch's clock, not mine. Not yours either.
